versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked: extraction/verify_all.py fails the run if it drifts from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's own allowlistVersion field. tokenCatalogVersion is likewise machine-checked against tokens/llm/token-catalog.json's own catalogVersion field, and the catalog's full id set is separately recomputed from the real tokens/00-foundation/**, tokens/10-semantic/semantic.json, tokens/20-component/component.json, tokens/30-layout/layout.json, and tokens/themes/light.json files on every run (fails on drift). tokenPolicyVersion is checked against tokens/llm/token-policy.json's own policyVersion field, and the policy's rawValueRestrictions category keys are checked to exist as real tokens/llm/token-catalog.json foundation categories. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are documentation-only, hand-maintained markers -- nothing automatically enforces them; they exist for human changelog tracking only.

sourceProject.name: wavelength-clone
sourceProject.description: Pixel-fidelity React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind v3 clone of the original marketing site (an AI-native CRM product, formerly branded 'Assembly'; link omitted from this repo). Real, live company/product -- see assets/asset-roles.json and README.md for compliance/licensing guidance.

countsNote: Recomputed from disk by extraction/verify_all.py on every run (globs tokens/**, primitives/*.json, components/*.json, sections/*.json, templates/templates.json's own templates[] and routeCount) -- not a hand-maintained number. A drift-injection test proves this check actually fails on a wrong count (see extraction/verify_all.py's own test harness note and the adversarial suite).
entryPointsNote: Every entryPoints value is a path INSIDE this design-repo/ folder -- none reference the sibling app (src/, CLONE_SPEC.md, PAGES_SPEC.md, recon/, etc.). Those sibling citations live in extraction/measured-values.json instead, which degrades gracefully (warns, does not fail) when that sibling source tree isn't present -- see its own _note field.
